info.title: Finance Calendar API
info.summary: Economic releases, central bank decisions and exchange holidays as JSON, CSV and ICS.
info.description: Economic releases, decisions and exchange holidays with per-event publisher provenance and verification status. Coverage, consensus and results vary by source and series; inspect status, last_verified_at and data_stale before use. Cancelled releases remain in calendar/history responses but are excluded from next, upcoming and last pointers. Free for any use, commercial included, with attribution: a visible link to https://www.financecalendar.com wherever the data appears. No key needed; a free key raises the daily limit. Earnings dates are not included.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: YYYY-MM-DD, default today (America/New_York).

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: YYYY-MM-DD, default from + 14 days, at most 92 days after from.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: ISO alpha-2, comma-separated for several (US, GB, EU, DE, JP, CA, AU, CN, CH, NZ, NO, SE, IN, HK). uk and eurozone are accepted.

parameters.name: impact
parameters.description: high, medium or low; comma-separated for several.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: economic-indicators, central-banks-monetary-policy or market-holidays. Market holidays are left out unless asked for here or with include=holidays.

parameters.name: series
parameters.description: Series code or alias (e.g. us-cpi, fomc, uk-cpi); comma-separated for several.

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: holidays to add market-holiday rows to the economic rows.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: confirmed, estimated, released, rescheduled, cancelled; comma-separated.

parameters.name: tz
parameters.description: IANA timezone; adds time_local to every row (e.g. Europe/London).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: 1 to 500, default 100.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Skip this many rows (paging).

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: json (default), csv (download) or ics (calendar subscription).

parameters.name: X-API-Key
parameters.description: Optional free API key (raises the daily limit and identifies your app). Also accepted as ?api_key=.

429.description: Daily limit reached (keyless 2,000/day per IP; free key 10,000/day).

Event.description: One scheduled release, decision or market holiday.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2; EU for euro-area releases.

date.description: Release date in the publisher's local calendar.

release_at_utc.description: Exact release instant when known. Null for date-only, unknown-time and range schedules; a range is represented by time_window_start and time_window_end.

time_local.description: HH:MM in the requested tz (only when ?tz= is given).

period.description: What the data covers, when known.

source_id.description: Publisher connector identifier; null when provenance is unavailable.

native_id.description: Publisher release identifier, when supplied. Stable across date changes.

release_stage.description: Publisher-labelled release stage, e.g. advance, second, third or annual-update. Null when unspecified.

time_precision.description: Publisher timing precision, e.g. minute, date or range. A date-only or range release is not an all-day market closure.

last_verified_at.description: Last successful live publisher fetch. Null for unverified or static schedule rows; snapshot generation is not verification.

data_stale.description: True when last-good publisher data is retained through a source outage. False does not imply live verification.

url.description: Preview and results page on financecalendar.com, when one exists.

starts_on.description: First day of a multi-day meeting (only when it differs from date).

note.description: Source note, e.g. a date the official calendar moved.

time_window_start.description: Start of the publisher-announced release window, with timezone offset. This bound is not an exact publication instant.

time_window_end.description: End of the publisher-announced release window, with timezone offset.

time_role.description: Meaning of the scheduled time or window, e.g. publication or auction-close. An auction close is not the publication time of auction results.

auction.description: Treasury auction security and result fields when available. Numerical values remain publisher decimal strings without unit conversion. Auction closing time is not result publication time.

old.description: Previous field value; structured auction metadata is an object.

new.description: Updated field value; structured auction metadata is an object.

fetched_at.description: Null if no successful live fetch occurred; checked-in schedules do not count as a fetch.

error.description: Credential-safe collector diagnostic, without request URLs or response bodies.

reported.description: False for snapshots without source-health reporting; this means unknown, not healthy.

stale_events.description: Events explicitly marked as retained last-good data during source outages.

x-attribution.how: A visible link to https://www.financecalendar.com near the data, or on your credits page.
